  - Thunderbird Mail icon
  - Date and Time: Oct 22 20:54

  - System status icons (network, sound, power) on the right

## Top Menu Bar

- **Search Bar**:
  - Placeholder text: "Search..."
  - Keyboard shortcut: CTRL + K
  - Magnifying glass icon for search
- **Window Control Buttons** (top-right):

  - Maximize button

- **Active Tab**: Address Book
- **Other Tabs**:

- **Action Buttons**:
  - New Address Book (with dropdown)
  - New Contact
  - New List

  - All Address Books
  - Personal Address Book
  - Collected Addresses

  - Email: anonym-x2024@outlook.com
  - Highlighted with blue background

  - "Total contacts in all address books: 1"
- **Status Indicator**:
  - "Done" with double arrow icon (<<)

## Main Content Area (Contact Details)

- **Contact Profile**:
  - Avatar: Default user icon (gray silhouette)
  - Name: anonym-x2024
  - Email: anonym-x2024@outlook.com
- **Action Buttons**:
  - Write (pencil icon)
  - Search (magnifying glass icon)
  - Edit (gray button on the right)
- **Contact Information Section**:
  - Title: Email Addresses
  - Email: anonym-x2024@outlook.com (blue, clickable hyperlink)

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)

- **Application Icons** (top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail

  - LibreOffice Writer

  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (question mark)
  - Trash

## Bottom Dock

- **Grid Icon**: App drawer launcher
- **Settings Icon**: Gear icon
- **Navigation Arrow**: Left arrow (<<)
